title: Auto mode behind an LLM gateway or with telemetry off now asks or denies calls instead of using the built-in classifier
symptoms: Auto mode prompts for or refuses tool calls that used to run unattended after upgrading to 2.1.319
Setups with telemetry or feature flags off, or behind an LLM gateway, no longer fall back to the built-in classifier
/status may show 'Auto mode server: Enabled' misleadingly on older versions even though the gateway drops the review
cause: From 2.1.319, when telemetry or feature flags are off (including behind LLM gateways), calls the server cannot check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier. Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged.
fix: Set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 to keep using the built-in classifier. If you want the server-side check behind a gateway and have CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS set, set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1 as well, and in managed settings put the 1 there too.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.319 and later, with DISABLE_TELEMETRY, disabled feature flags, or an LLM gateway base URL
